people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.
translations.bsb: “From others,” Peter answered. “Then the sons are exempt,” Jesus said to him.
translations.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
translations.asv: And when he said, From strangers, Jesus said unto him, Therefore the sons are free.
